text:
maria: quick idea — add a small 'safety sweep' command to the deploy bot that runs an inline preflight, pins the version for the change window, and annotates release notes. thinking CLI shape: `/deploy sweep --branch=staging --safety-window=30m --dry-run --annotate`

sam: nice. +1 for the annotate. can we make the safety-window default to 15m but allow override? also add `--hold-until` to respect change windows.

ben: we should include an explicit fast-rollback path in the flow. maybe `/deploy sweep` produces a rollout-id; then `/deploy rollback <rollout-id> --reason="regression" --fast` handles immediate unwind and posts to incidents.

maria: rough command sketch i tested locally:
```
# run checks and produce a rollout id (dry-run)
/deploy sweep --branch=staging --safety-window=30m --dry-run --annotate "perf rollout"
# apply after review
/deploy apply --rollout-id=ROLL123 --confirm
```

olivia: tiny ask: bot should attach two labels to the rollout metadata: `release-note:` and `rollout-id:` so the console can surface it in the release timeline. also expose a quick link to the release notes editor.

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight results for ROLL123 (dry-run): lint=ok, smoke=ok, capacity=ok, kv-cache-hit=15%. Use `/deploy apply --rollout-id=ROLL123` to proceed. :white_check_mark:

sam: Also add `--pin-version=<semver|commit>` so we lock the service/model binary during the window. prevents mid-rollout autosync changes.

maria: agree. also want a `--grace-period` flag (default 5m) — if canaries look bad, auto-rollback after grace unless `--hold-until` is set by oncall. gives brief manual time to triage.

ben: on the ops side, here's a tiny helper for forcing an unwind from shell (for oncall):
```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ROLLID="$1"
notify_channel="#incidents"
deployctl rollback --id "$ROLLID" --force || exit 1
slack-post --channel "$notify_channel" --text "rollback executed for $ROLLID by oncall"
```

olivia: console UX: show a compact "safety sweep" state with checklist items (lint, smoke, perf-snapshot) and a prominent rollback button with `--fast` tooltip. also surface change-window start/end and pin info.

sam: i'll take PoC for CLI + bot changes (PoC branch: tools/sweep-poc). target: next sprint.

maria: ben can you draft a short runbook snippet for the rollback path and release-note hooks? olivia, can you mock console tiles by Wed?

ben: yep, will drop a short md in docs/runbooks/ by Tue.

maria: one more small thought — annotate flag should support `--eval=true` to auto-run a small perf/eval harness and attach scores to the rollout metadata. helps detect regressions early.

sam: good call. we'll gate `--eval` on a feature-flag first.

olivia: sounds good. staging rollout scheduled tomorrow 11:00 PT for sweep validation. ping if blocked.

maria: thanks all — action items summarized: sam=PoC cli+bot, olivia=console mock, ben=runbook + rollback script, maria=release-note template update. i'll follow up with PR links. :rocket:

sam: SG. :thumbsup:

olivia: thanks!
